firstPlayerRule: Everyone declares the largest number of their blocks that share one color or one shape, not counting duplicates. The player with the most plays those blocks to start the game.
officialTieBreak: If there is a tie, the oldest player in the tie starts the game.
clarifications: Play proceeds clockwise around the table.
internalEvidence: Downloaded MindWare's Qwirkle instructions (item 32016) from MindWare's own instruction host and extracted the text with pdftotext. The single-page English section "Starting the Game" names the player with the most blocks sharing one color or shape, the oldest player in a tie, and clockwise play. Components (108 blocks, six colors and six shapes), © 2006 MindWare and "Game design by Susan McKinley Ross" confirm the game.
